Imperfect Subjunctive (Imperfecto de Subjuntivo)
Hypotheticals, polite requests, and past subjunctive triggers
3rd person plural preterite stem + -ra / -ras / -ra / -ramos / -ran
Si tuviera más tiempo, aprendería otro idioma.
see too-BYEH-rah mahs TYEHM-poh ah-prehn-deh-REE-ah OH-troh ee-DYOH-mah
If I had more time, I would learn another language.
Quería que vinieras a la reunión.
keh-REE-ah keh bee-NYEH-rahs ah lah reh-oo-NYOHN
I wanted you to come to the meeting.
Si Clauses (2nd & 3rd Conditionals)
Expressing unlikely or counterfactual conditions
Si + Imperfect Subjunctive, Conditional | Si + Pluperfect Subjunctive, Conditional Perfect
Si viviéramos cerca, nos veríamos más.
see bee-BYEH-rah-mohs SEHR-kah nohs beh-REE-ah-mohs mahs
If we lived closer, we would see each other more.
Si hubiera sabido eso, habría actuado distinto.
see oo-BYEH-rah sah-BEE-doh EH-soh ah-BREE-ah ahk-TWAH-doh dees-TEEN-toh
If I had known that, I would have acted differently.
Passive 'Se' (Pasiva Refleja)
Describing general rules, signs, and impersonal processes
se + 3rd person singular/plural verb (matches noun number)
Aquí se habla español.
ah-KEE seh AH-blah ehs-pah-NYOHL
Spanish is spoken here.
Se venden pisos en el centro.
seh BEHN-dehn PEE-sohs ehn ehl SEHN-troh
Apartments are sold in the city center.
Verbal Periphrases of Change (ponerse a / dejar de / volver a)
Nuanced aspectual shifts: starting, stopping, repeating
ponerse a + inf (start) | dejar de + inf (stop) | volver a + inf (do again)
Dejó de fumar hace tres años.
deh-HOH deh foo-MAHR AH-seh trehs AH-nyohs
He/she quit smoking three years ago.
Volvimos a analizar los resultados.
bohl-BEE-mohs ah ah-nah-lee-SAHR lohs reh-sool-TAH-dohs
We analyzed the results again.
Concessive Connectors (aunque / a pesar de que)
Distinguishing factual concessions (indicative) from hypothetical ones (subjunctive)
aunque + Indicative (known fact) | aunque + Subjunctive (hypothetical/dismissive)
Aunque llueve mucho, saldremos.
OWN-keh YWEH-beh MOO-choh sahl-DREH-mohs
Even though it is raining a lot, we will go out.
Aunque llueva mañana, iremos al museo.
OWN-keh YWEH-bah mah-NYAH-nah ee-REH-mohs ahl moo-SEH-oh
Even if it rains tomorrow, we will go to the museum.
